# Skinora

> Skinora is an online store in Sri Lanka for 100% authentic international skincare and fragrance. Every product comes from brand-authorised distributors, is cleared through Sri Lanka Customs by Skinora Imports (Pvt) Ltd, and shows its batch number and expiry date before you buy. Prices are in LKR.

## Key facts
- Delivery: island-wide. Same-day or next-day in Colombo, 1 to 2 days in Gampaha and Kalutara, 2 to 5 days elsewhere. Free over LKR 15,000; otherwise from LKR 350.
- Returns: unopened items within 14 days for a full refund or exchange. Opened items only if faulty or you have a reaction.
- Payment: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Koko and Mintpay (pay in 3), bank transfer, cash on delivery up to LKR 75,000.
- Storage: climate-controlled at 18 to 22°C in Colombo. Dispatched first-expiry-first-out.
- Contact: WhatsApp or call +94 77 123 4567, email care@skinora.lk. Atelier: 42 Flower Road, Colombo 07.
- Free tools: AI skin scan and skin quiz (https://skinora-git-final-site-shehan12.vercel.app/quiz.html), scent finder (https://skinora-git-final-site-shehan12.vercel.app/scent-finder.html).
